build_lovasz_loss_module: build a LovaszLoss module for binary or multi-class semantic segmentation with configurable class weights
run_lovasz_hinge_loss: run the binary Lovasz hinge loss on flattened logits and binary ground truth labels
run_lovasz_softmax_loss: run the multi-class Lovasz-Softmax loss on class probabilities and ground truth labels
review_lovasz_grad: review the lovasz_grad function that computes the gradient of the Lovasz extension w.r.t sorted errors
test_flatten_probs: test the flatten_probs function that reshapes batch predictions from B,C,H,W to B*H*W,C format
